svg.title: Build log
svg.desc: Recent launches: Wind Forecast Monitor — Day-ahead wind forecasts checked against real output; Digital Dark Spot — Finds what research sources leave out; VISTARA-X — Predictive vision-based navigation, in simulation; FormPilot — One verified profile, reused across application forms; Streamly — Synced two-person watch party with a video call; NEXUS — Simulated AI decision support for disaster response. Own repositories by primary language: JavaScript 21, Python 15, Jupyter Notebook 15, TypeScript 10, HTML 5, CSS 2. 72 own repositories, 42 created in 2026, 15 live sites, as of 05 Nov 2026.
